Several days (8 tombs, one or more sessions per tomb)

Seven advisors of the Pharaoh each guard, in their own tomb beneath the Ankrahmun desert, a piece of an ancient mask. You go down into the 8 {wiki:Ankrahmun Tombs|tombs}, kill all the {wiki:Pharaohs|pharaohs}, collect the 7 pieces and put them together in {creature:Ashmunrah}'s treasure room to receive the {item:Helmet of the Ancients}.
Seven of the Pharaoh's advisors were "entrusted" with the secret of forging part of an ancient and powerful mask, and they will fight for all eternity to guard it.
Ancient Ruins Tomb (Vashresamun), the recommended first pharaoh
Minimum level 75 for the experience doors (120+ recommended).
Strong team: about 5 players of level 75+ or 3 players of level 150+.
At least 8 {item:Scarab Coin|Scarab Coins} (one per tomb; bring extra).
For Thalas: 6 more people from outside the team to press the switches at the same time.
For Morguthis: at least one knight (two at step 33) to block and push Deathslicers.
one per tomb, per player who passes the flame; bring extra
to open the holes in the desert

useful on the last step of Morguthis
optional, to enchant the helmet at the end

Each pharaoh (except Ashmunrah) drops a **pass item** every time he dies. With that item in your inventory, the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the pharaoh's room takes you to the {item:Sarcophagus} room, where you get the helmet piece. Without it, the forcefield sends you back to the start of the tomb.
Each piece can only be picked up **once per character**, and each player needs their own pass item: the team has to kill each pharaoh **at least once for each person** who needs the piece.
Ashmunrah has no piece or pass item and only has to be killed once, but he must be the **last** one.
The order of the other pharaohs doesn't matter. From easiest to hardest: Vashresamun, Rahemos, Dipthrah, Omruc, Thalas, Mahrdis, Morguthis, Ashmunrah.

In every tomb, to get to the deep parts you have to step on the {item:Mystic Flame} (blue flame) and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the empty {item:Coal Basin}. Scarab Coins are obtained by digging at certain spots in the sand north of Ankrahmun or as loot from various creatures.
Summary: pharaohs, pass items and pieces
Keep this table: it tells you which pass item you need to reach each helmet piece.

After killing a pharaoh, pick up the pass item from the body. With it in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the pharaoh's room: instead of going to the start of the tomb, you appear in a small room with the pharaoh's {item:Sarcophagus}. Use the sarcophagus to receive the helmet piece.
Each player needs **their own** pass item. If the team has 5 people doing the quest, the pharaoh has to die 5 times.
Getting to Ankrahmun and the tombs

All the tombs are under the Kha'labal desert, around **Ankrahmun** (Ashmunrah's is under the city itself). To get to Ankrahmun take a boat: for example {npc:Captain Seahorse} in Edron ({key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}, 160 gp) or the captains in Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Darashia, Venore and Yalahar. You land next to {npc:Captain Sinbeard}. Each section below gives the coordinates of the tomb entrance: walk there and dig with the {item:Shovel} in the right spot.

The {item:Magic Forcefield} in each pharaoh's room, used **without** the pass item in your inventory, takes you to the **start of the tomb**. In Vashresamun's tomb, the sarcophagus room has an exit teleport that leaves you at the tomb entrance. In other tombs, if you don't see an exit teleport, go back the way you came. From the start of the tomb, climb the ramps/stairs to the hole you opened in the sand and use the {item:Rope} to return to the surface. To leave Ankrahmun, {npc:Captain Sinbeard} takes you to Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Venore or Yalahar ({key:hi}, the city name, {key:yes}).
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Ancient Ruins Tomb} and dig with the {item:Shovel} to open the hole.
Go down to the tomb's **7th floor**, where the {item:Coal Basin} is. Step on the blue flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin. You are teleported to the deep part of the tomb.
Follow the map to reach the next floor.
Follow the map to the next teleport and step into it.
Pass the level 75 experience door. Click each musical instrument **in the order shown in the image** to open the next door.

After the door there is a teleport. Step in: you appear in {creature:Vashresamun}'s room with 2–4 {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, 4 {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers} and 2 {creature:Shredderthrower|Shredderthrowers}. Kill the pharaoh and pick up the {item:Blue Note}.
If you don't move after entering, you are only attacked by 2 throwers, 2 banshees and the pharaoh.
With the {item:Blue Note}, walk **west** and enter the teleport. You appear in Vashresamun's treasure room. Use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Left Horn}.
Step into the exit teleport: you appear at the tomb entrance, 1 floor below the sand. Go up with the {item:Rope} through the hole you came in by and return to Ankrahmun.
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Oasis Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Go down to floor -4 and follow the map to the next floor.
Follow the map to the {item:Coal Basin}. Step on the blue flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin.
Go down the stairs and follow the map.
Follow the next map to the teleport and enter. Then pass the level 75 experience door.
**Each** team member has to find the {item:Carrot} under one of the three hats to be able to pass the door.
If you get it wrong you lose 200 health.
Ignore the switches and follow the path in the image.
Ignore the switches again and follow the coin path over the lava.
After the lava go down the stairs and kill the 9 {creature:Demongoblin|Demongoblins}.
Step into the teleport: it takes you to {creature:Rahemos}, 0–1 {creature:Demon}, 1 {creature:Warlock} and 1 {creature:Magicthrower}. Kill him and pick up the {item:Ancient Rune}.
With the {item:Ancient Rune} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Helmet Piece}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Oasis Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Mountain Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Go down to floor -6, where the {item:Coal Basin} is. Step on the blue flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin. You are teleported to the deep part.
**Ignore** the teleport and press the switches marked on the map until they **all face right**. You can do it in any order and with no time limit.
Switches to turn to the right
With all the switches facing right, go back to the teleport and step in: you go to the 7th floor.
Go **south** and follow the map to the next teleport. Step in, go south and pass the level 75 experience door.
Go through the doors in this order: **endless**, **pale-faced**, **deceased**, **unholy**, **doomed**, **righteous**, **sharpened**, **mortal**.
This sequence comes in a {wiki:Ancient Tombs (Book)|book}. You don't need to find it for the quest, but it's recommended if you want the **Poet Laureate** achievement.

The next teleport takes you to {creature:Dipthrah}, 9 {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers}, 5 {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and 0–4 {creature:Priestess|Priestesses}. Kill him and pick up the {item:Ornamented Ankh}.
Dipthrah is **immune to physical and death damage**. Use other elements. Bring a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
With the {item:Ornamented Ankh} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Damaged Helmet}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Mountain Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
Go to the {wiki:Peninsula Tomb}, which is hidden, and dig at the indicated spot.
Hidden entrance of the Peninsula Tomb
You may have to dig several times before the hole appears.
Go down to floor -5 and follow the map to the {item:Empty Coal Basin}.
Path on floor -5 to the Coal Basin
Step on the {item:Mystic Flame} and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the {item:Empty Coal Basin}. Then follow the next map.
Follow the map to the maze teleport and step in.
Now you're in a maze of invisible walls. Follow the arrows in the image **exactly**: there are other squares you can step on, but this is the only path that leads to the end.
Correct path through the invisible maze (arrows)

Step into the teleport to the **south**: you go to {creature:Omruc}, 2 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, 6 {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers} and 6 {creature:Shredderthrower|Shredderthrowers}. Kill him and pick up the {item:Crystal Arrow}.
With the {item:Crystal Arrow} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Helmet Adornment}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Peninsula Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
You need 6 people from outside the team for this part (or a big team).
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Stone Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Go down to floor -6, where the {item:Coal Basin} is. Step on the blue flame, put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin and follow the map.

On the last floor you have to activate **all** the switches. Put the 6 extra people on the 6 **yellow** spots and 2 team players on the 2 **blue** spots. Everyone else stands at the teleport, on the **red** spot.
Yellow, blue and red switch spots
After the first switch you have about **4 minutes** to enter the teleport.
Pressing the switches at the same time
Everyone presses the switches **at the same time**. The 2 players on the blue spots go straight back to the group at the teleport.
Getting poisoned and talking to the Cobra

Each player steps on the switch to get **poisoned**. While poisoned, say {key:hi} to the {npc:Cobra (NPC)} to the **south**. You are teleported to {creature:Thalas}'s room, with 12 {creature:Plaguethrower|Plaguethrowers}, 4 {creature:Necromancer|Necromancers} and 0–8 {creature:Slime|Slimes}.
If you're not quick, the Cobra answers *"Begone! Hissssss! You bear not the mark of the cobra!"* and doesn't teleport you.
Kill {creature:Thalas} and pick up the {item:Cobrafang Dagger}.
With the {item:Cobrafang Dagger} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Gem Holder}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Stone Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Go down to floor -5 and walk a little **west** to reach floor -6.
Walk **south** to the blue flame and the {item:Coal Basin}. Step on the flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin. You are teleported to the deep part.
Walk **west** to reach the floor below. Then follow the map to the teleport.
Climb the spiral tower (level 75 experience door) and keep going straight.

You reach a room with {item:Purple Fire} on the floor. Step **only** on the "cold" squares (no fire). If the fire appears under you when you're already on a cold square, you don't lose health, so don't rush.
Stepping on Purple Fire takes 300 health from you.
Step into the teleport to fight {creature:Mahrdis}, 4 {creature:Flamethrower|Flamethrowers}, 2 {creature:Dragon|Dragons} and 1 {creature:Dragon Lord}. Kill him and pick up the {item:Burning Heart}.
With the {item:Burning Heart} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Helmet Ornament}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Shadow Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
The most complicated tomb: a maze with {creature:Deathslicer|Deathslicers} that don't die (but can be pushed). You need at least one knight to block.
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Tarpit Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Go down to the teleport flame. On each floor the ramps down are easy to spot. Step on the flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin.
After the flame, follow the maps to the last hunting floor and another teleport.

Pass the level 75 door and you reach Morguthis' arena. To get to the pharaoh you have to step on **all the blue flames** in the maze, which means entering all the caves. The trapdoors lead to caves that connect to different parts of the maze. Each cave teleport takes you onto a nearby "sandstone switch tile", in a safe spot. You only face Deathslicers when you cross the sandstone part to enter another trapdoor.
All the flames, teleports and trapdoors are safe, **except** the final teleport (the only one that is not inside a cave, it leads to Morguthis) and the first teleport (before the level 75 doors).
This is the fastest route (you can step on the flames in a different order, as long as you step on all of them). Follow the image and the table.
A knight goes through the **right** level door and blocks the Deathslicer; the rest of the team goes through the **left** door and enters the trapdoor.
Go down through the hole, **not** the teleport.
Pass the blue flame and then go up with the rope to the north.
Go up with the rope again.
Walk north and go down through the hole.
Walk east and step into the teleport.
The knight goes northeast and blocks the Deathslicer; the team goes west, then north, and enters the trapdoor.
Walk west and go up with the rope.
Walk south and go down through the hole.
Go north and go down through the hole again.
Follow the path east and go up with the rope.
Pass the blue flame to the north and go down through the hole.
Walk north and go up with the rope.
The knight blocks the Deathslicer to the west; the team goes east and then north, to the trapdoor.
Walk south and pass the blue flame. Keep going south and step into the teleport.
The knight goes south and blocks the Deathslicer (he may have to push it south); the team goes south and enters the west corridor.
Go south, to the hole, **not** to the teleport.
Head east and go up with the rope.
Walk north to the blue flame. Keep going north and step into the teleport.
The knight goes left (he does **not** enter the teleport, that's Morguthis') and blocks the Deathslicer, pushing it if needed; the team goes south and enters the trapdoor.
Go north and go down through the hole (do **not** enter the teleport).
Go south and go up through the rope hole.
Go left and pass the blue flame; keep going north and go down through the hole.
Go southwest and go up through the rope hole.
Go west and go up through the rope hole.
Go south and go down through the hole.
Go south and step into the teleport.
The knight goes right and may have to push the Deathslicer south and to the right, so the team can pass and enter the trapdoor.
Go west and go down through the hole (do **not** enter the teleport!).
Go north, pass the blue flame and go up through the rope hole.
Go north and step into the teleport.
**Two knights** are needed here: one goes right and blocks the first Deathslicer, the other goes south and blocks the second. They may have to push them so the team can pass and enter the trapdoor.
Go north and go down through the hole (do not enter the teleport).
Follow the corridor northeast, then southeast, pass the blue flame, continue along the path and go up through the rope hole.
Go east and step into the teleport.
The knight goes right and pushes the Deathslicer down, so the team can go north and enter the trapdoor (the one at the **north** door, not the northwest one).
Go southeast (do not enter the teleport!), pass the blue flame, continue along the path and this time enter the teleport.
Go south (don't go left); the knight pushes the Deathslicer so the whole team can pass through the **second** corridor on the left and enter the trapdoor.
Go east and go down through the hole (not the teleport!).
Head east and go up with the rope.
Walk north to the blue flame. Keep going north and step into the teleport.
The knight goes left and blocks the Deathslicer (or uses {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Wall}) so the team can enter the teleport to the north.
After the teleport at step 43, {creature:Morguthis} and his summons are waiting for you.
Kill {creature:Morguthis} and pick up the {item:Sword Hilt}.
With the {item:Sword Hilt} in your inventory, step into the {item:Magic Forcefield} in the room and use the {item:Sarcophagus} to receive the {item:Right Horn}.

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Tarpit Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
Only come here when you have **all 7 pieces** of the helmet.
Go to the entrance of the {wiki:Ankrahmun Library Tomb} and dig to open the hole.
Follow the map to the {item:Coal Basin}. Step on the blue flame and put a {item:Scarab Coin} in the Coal Basin.
Follow the map to the teleport and step in.
Follow the path in the image to the next room.
You will be attacked by many {creature:Shredderthrower|Shredderthrowers}, {creature:Plaguethrower|Plaguethrowers}, {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers} and {creature:Flamethrower|Flamethrowers}.
Wait for the {item:Purple Fire} to go out and run to the next room.
Once again, many Shredderthrowers, Plaguethrowers, Magicthrowers and Flamethrowers.

In the next room there is a teleport to {creature:Ashmunrah}, 4 {creature:Magicthrower|Magicthrowers}, 1 {creature:Behemoth}, 4 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}, 0–3 {creature:Green Djinn|Green Djinns} and 0–2 {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs}. Ashmunrah only needs to die once.
For the treasure room teleport to work, **all the switches** must face **right**. This has to be done **once for each team member**.

In the treasure room, put the 7 pieces ({item:Left Horn}, {item:Right Horn}, {item:Helmet Piece}, {item:Damaged Helmet}, {item:Helmet Adornment}, {item:Gem Holder}, {item:Helmet Ornament}) on the small stone table to the **north**. You receive the {item:Helmet of the Ancients}.
Stone table where you assemble the helmet

To return to the surface, follow the directions in **Leaving a tomb** (at the start of the guide): go back to the start of the {wiki:Ankrahmun Library Tomb} and climb out through the entrance hole with the {item:Rope}.
To turn the helmet into a {item:Helmet of the Ancients (Enchanted)}, put a {item:Small Ruby} on the helmet. Each ruby only lasts 30 minutes; there are rumours that a Soul Ruby would last forever.

The tombs have many more monsters along the way ({creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}, {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, scorpions, skeletons...). Bring enough potions for each tomb.
